sentences.text:
Appearance:
 Shri Manish Tiwari - Advocate for the applicant.
Shri V.K. Pandey - Dy. Government Advocate for State.

Order 
This is the third bail application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of BNSS/ 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.204/2024 registered at Police Station - Khurai, District- Sagar (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366-A, 376(2)(n), 376(2)(i), 376(3) of IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act.
Applicant is in detention since 21.06.2024.
Earlier bail applications were dismissed as withdrawn.
2 . As per the prosecution story, allegation against the applicant is of committing rape upon the minor prosecutrix.
After investigation, offence under the aforesaid sections has been registered against the applicant.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant has falsely been implicated in the present case.
The applicant is in jail since 21.06.2024.
Age of the prosecutrix is more than 16 years and she is consenting party.
At the time of medical examination, prosecutrix has told that she is the NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:21449 2 MCRC-13353-2025 consenting party.
In her statement recorded under Section 164 of the Cr.P.C. she has not stated against the applicant.
There is no criminal record of the applicant.
Charge sheet has been filed.
Conclusion of the trial will take considerable time, therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant may be released on bail.
4. On the other hand, learned counsel for State has opposed the grant of bail to the applicant and submitted that at the time of incident age of the prosecutrix was 15 years and 4 months.
Applicant has committed rape upon the minor prosecutrix therefore, in this case consent of minor has no value.
DNA report is also positive.
During investigation and even in the Court statement, prosecutrix has deposed against the applicant.

It is also submitted that minute appreciation of evidence cannot Ajay @ Chhotu Chholelal Kuswaha vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/75416032/
1 be done at this stage.

sentences.text:
Hence, he prayed for rejection of bail application.
5.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
6 . Looking to aforesaid facts and circumstances as well as act of present applicant, I am not inclined to grant bail to the present applicant.
7. Accordingly, present MCRC stands dismissed.
8. Certified copy as per rules.

(PRAMOD KUMAR AGRAWAL) JUDGE shahina Ajay @ Chhotu Chholelal Kuswaha vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/75416032/
